# Comcast
> Comcast provides Xfinity internet, TV, mobile, email, voice, business, and customer support services.

Comcast.net and related Xfinity properties provide account management, email access, service support, troubleshooting, billing help, and product information for residential and business customers.

## Account & Sign In
- [Comcast.net](https://www.comcast.net/): Main portal for Comcast and Xfinity customers with links to email, support, and account tools.
- [Xfinity Sign In](https://login.xfinity.com/login): Sign in to Xfinity accounts for email, billing, and service management.
- [My Account](https://www.xfinity.com/support/my-account): Access account management help for billing, services, users, and preferences.
- [Xfinity Customer Center](https://customer.xfinity.com/): Manage account settings, billing, appointments, and subscribed services online.
- [Create Xfinity ID](https://login.xfinity.com/create): Create a new Xfinity ID for account access and service management.
- [Password Help](https://idm.xfinity.com/myaccount/reset): Reset or recover Xfinity account passwords and sign-in access.

## Email
- [Xfinity Email](https://connect.xfinity.com/): Access Xfinity email, voicemail, contacts, and calendar from the web.
- [Comcast Email Help](https://www.xfinity.com/support/email): Support hub for Xfinity email setup, troubleshooting, and feature guidance.
- [Email Settings](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/email-client-programs-with-xfinity-email): Configure third-party email clients using Xfinity email server settings.
- [Import Contacts](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/import-xfinity-connect-address-book-contacts): Import contacts into Xfinity email address books from other services.
- [Delete or Recover Email](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/delete-email-accidentally-deleted): Learn options for handling deleted Xfinity email messages.
- [Voicemail in Xfinity Connect](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/access-xfinity-connect-voice-mail): Access and manage voicemail through Xfinity Connect.

## Internet Support
- [Internet Support](https://www.xfinity.com/support/internet): Main support area for Xfinity internet service, setup, speed, and troubleshooting.
- [Restart Your Gateway](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/troubleshooting-your-cable-modem): Troubleshoot internet issues and restart compatible Xfinity gateways.
- [WiFi Network Help](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/view-change-wifi-password): View or change WiFi names and passwords for home networks.
- [xFi Overview](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/xfi-overview): Learn about xFi features for WiFi management, security, and connected devices.
- [Internet Troubleshooting Checklist](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/internet-connectivity-troubleshooting): Follow steps to diagnose common Xfinity internet connectivity problems.
- [Speed Test](https://speedtest.xfinity.com/): Test internet download and upload speeds on Xfinity connections.

## TV & Streaming Support
- [TV Support](https://www.xfinity.com/support/tv): Support resources for Xfinity TV service, equipment, channels, and troubleshooting.
- [X1 Overview](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/x1-overview): Introduction to Xfinity X1 features, navigation, and entertainment capabilities.
- [Flex Support](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/xfinity-flex-overview): Learn about Xfinity Flex streaming device features and setup.
- [Stream App Help](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/getting-started-with-xfinity-tv-mobile-app): Get started with the Xfinity Stream app on mobile devices.
- [Remote Control Setup](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/programming-your-xfinity-remote): Program and use Xfinity remotes with TVs and X1 devices.
- [Channel Lineup](https://www.xfinity.com/learn/channel-lineup): Browse Xfinity TV channel lineup information by market.

## Mobile & Voice
- [Xfinity Mobile Support](https://www.xfinity.com/mobile/support): Support hub for Xfinity Mobile plans, devices, billing, and troubleshooting.
- [Mobile Device Activation](https://www.xfinity.com/mobile/support/article/how-to-activate-your-phone): Activate a phone on Xfinity Mobile service.
- [Bring Your Own Device](https://www.xfinity.com/mobile/byod): Check eligibility and bring compatible devices to Xfinity Mobile.
- [Voice Support](https://www.xfinity.com/support/voice): Support resources for Xfinity Voice service and calling features.
- [Voicemail Setup](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/setting-up-voice2go): Set up and manage voicemail and related voice features.
- [International Calling](https://www.xfinity.com/learn/voice/international): Learn about Xfinity Voice international calling options and rates.

## Billing & Payments
- [Billing Support](https://www.xfinity.com/support/billing): Help with bills, payments, statements, credits, and account charges.
- [Pay Your Bill](https://customer.xfinity.com/bill-pay): Make one-time or recurring payments for Xfinity services.
- [Paperless Billing](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/sign-up-for-paperless-billing): Enroll in paperless billing and manage billing preferences.
- [Auto Pay](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/xfinity-autopay): Set up or manage automatic bill payments.
- [Understanding Your Bill](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/new-bill-design): Learn how to read and understand Xfinity billing statements.
- [Billing History](https://customer.xfinity.com/billing/services): Review billing and service details in the customer portal.

## Equipment & Installation
- [Self-Install Help](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/activate-xfi-gateway-app): Activate Xfinity internet equipment and complete self-installation steps.
- [Equipment Returns](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/returning-your-equipment): Return Xfinity equipment by mail or at participating locations.
- [Find an Xfinity Store](https://www.xfinity.com/local/store-offers): Locate nearby Xfinity stores for service, pickups, and returns.
- [Modem and Router Compatibility](https://www.xfinity.com/support/devices): Check compatible retail devices for Xfinity internet service.
- [Professional Installation](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/what-to-expect-with-pro-install): Learn what to expect during professional installation appointments.
- [Activate Your Modem](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/xfinity-app-activation): Activate supported internet equipment using Xfinity tools.

## Apps & Tools
- [Xfinity App](https://www.xfinity.com/apps): Overview of Xfinity apps for account, WiFi, TV, and mobile management.
- [Xfinity Assistant](https://www.xfinity.com/xfinityassistant/): Virtual assistant for support questions, troubleshooting, and account help.
- [Status Center](https://www.xfinity.com/support/status): Check service outages, interruptions, and appointment status.
- [Xfinity Stream](https://www.xfinity.com/stream/): Stream live TV, on-demand content, and DVR recordings online.
- [WiFi Hotspots](https://www.xfinity.com/learn/internet-service/wifi): Learn about Xfinity WiFi hotspots and connectivity options.
- [Xfinity App Support](https://www.xfinity.com/support/articles/xfinity-app-overview): Get help using the Xfinity app for account and device management.

## Business
- [Comcast Business](https://business.comcast.com/): Business services for internet, voice, networking, cybersecurity, and communications.
- [Business Support](https://business.comcast.com/support): Support portal for Comcast Business products and account help.
- [Business Internet](https://business.comcast.com/internet): Business internet plans and connectivity solutions.
- [Business Voice](https://business.comcast.com/voice): Voice and phone solutions for business customers.
- [Business TV](https://business.comcast.com/tv): Television and entertainment offerings for business locations.
- [Business Mobile](https://business.comcast.com/mobile): Mobile service offerings for Comcast Business customers.

## Corporate & News
- [Comcast Corporation](https://corporate.comcast.com/): Corporate information, leadership, investor resources, and company initiatives.
- [Comcast Newsroom](https://corporate.comcast.com/news-information): Official company news, announcements, and press materials.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.cmcsa.com/): Investor information, filings, earnings, and stockholder resources.
- [Careers](https://jobs.comcast.com/): Explore jobs, hiring information, and career opportunities across Comcast.
- [NBCUniversal](https://www.nbcuniversal.com/): Media and entertainment business information within the Comcast portfolio.
- [Sky](https://www.skygroup.sky/): European media and telecommunications business in the Comcast portfolio.
